given.note: The warehouse export (C-037) writes the event log's rows of Mon Oct 19 (UTC) as one Parquet object, K-08 v1 export rows with their sealed values still sealed (arch 10 line 544: 'Event log to R2 Parquet. Reports and evals never touch the primary'). The key's day is the rows' day, so a reader takes one day's rows by the prefix eventLogExport/2026-10-19/. When the export runs is C-037's (README open gaps). Size and hash are placeholders.
